checks.name: design_and_baseline
checks.finding: Seven models, eight binary CET combinations, 1514 tasks in five scored sets (104+492+218+320+380); FDA report/choice share one benchmark family. Baseline already plans, executes tools and recovers; same 300-step/600-model-call ceilings are not equal realized budgets. Layer entries remain outside per-step rewritten memory.

checks.name: behavior_and_annotation
checks.finding: Twelve standardized trace features for Ward model-level clustering; frozen baseline k-means for run types; eight radar indicators are descriptive. Linkage instability and small-sample uncertainty for GPT-5.4 are real. Acting/nonacting accuracy is self-selected. Task-demand 96% agreement is 330 checked labels, behavior second-rater sample is 387 runs, wrong-value causes are 790 baseline plus three 220-case CET samples. Primary-cause agreement correction below is required.

checks.name: reasoning_and_controls
checks.finding: Default nonreasoning GPT-5.4 differs from other default models; medium/high effort improves its two task sets by about 35pp and exceeds its default-effort CET combinations. Forced GPT-5.5 arms reject final answers until a tool and additionally a matched realized call count; close only 7–37% of orchestration gap while costing 33–62% of orchestrated dollars. No equal-output-token or strong alternative search-prompt control, nor separate planner/specialist/verifier ablation, is supplied. No universal single-agent impossibility follows.

checks.name: semantic_layer_attribution
checks.finding: Whole-layer paired traces, not component-wise randomized ablations; 600-pair attribution uses moderately agreeing judges (kappa .41). 300 layer breaks and 100 investigator breaks are sampled. Correct candidate coverage 92–96% is not first opened source 27–42% or task correctness. Small-author transfer comparison is GPT-5.4 single agent/DataClaw only (+12.7 vs +14.7pp). Good map content can induce skipped checks.

checks.name: compaction_and_combinations
checks.finding: 92–100% computed-value retention does not establish correction/disagreement/dependency preservation; extra rewrite calls and looping can raise cost. Predictor AUC .79/.76 lacks disclosed generalization protocol and is not causality. >60k prompt subset halves tokens with -3.3pp accuracy. Baseline-only contrasts, marginal toggles over other configurations, and combined effects differ; negative marginal deltas cannot simply be added to printed standalone baseline counts. Combination gains and dollar products are nonadditive.

checks.name: statistics_and_aggregation
checks.finding: 95% task-bootstrap intervals and descriptive model groups do not establish repeated-run/model-family uncertainty, multiplicity control or causal mechanisms. Table 2 accuracy averages five heterogeneous benchmark metrics equally; Figure 29 per-task cost is pooled over tasks; group costs/ratios are geometric model means. Demand-level selections and shared benchmark provenance limit transfer. No raw repeats/missing-run ledger supplied in this body.

checks.name: benchmark_metric_denominators
checks.finding: Krama pipeline judge distinct from end-to-end score; DataClaw EE correct-only and GPR/TPE incorrect-only create changing populations; FDA reports rubric/ROUGE/tool-name/DAG scores differ from choice exact option sets/fallback evaluator; HDR timeout is 300 tool-calling turns or 3600 seconds. Tool success captions condition on attempted-tool runs, not unrestricted per-call reliability.

checks.name: cost_compute_reproducibility
checks.finding: Author list-price estimates as of 6 October 2026, reasoning charged as output; OpenAI cache shares estimated from 2800 runs, Claude recorded no cache, Gemini/GLM missing cache fields imply upper bounds, local free-API GLM imputed cheapest paid host. Early-stopper layer cost direction changes under cache-optimistic sensitivity. Layer build/embedding/retrieval/Sonar/tool CPU/GPU inclusion in task totals is not established. API CPU orchestration hardware is not provider model hardware; GLM BF16 A10080GB TP2/4 per-cell mapping unspecified. Reported timings pool configurations/tasks, not a controlled repository latency test. No pinned author code/traces access, served model IDs, complete prompts, seeds/repeats or raw usage ledger is provided here.

checks.name: repository_transfer_and_inventory_provenance
checks.evidence: Referenced six module interfaces and inventory-scan report
checks.finding: Existing ledger/handoff/TASK/provenance interfaces support preserving corrections and dependencies rather than creating another shared memory pool. Paper does not certify current host loading, semantic quality or all-role spend, and supplies no coding-domain/adaptive-policy transfer experiment. Inventory lead is separate local source/stdlib error-semantic inference; current referenced code contains the raising callback and report describes independently scoped repair. This review does not rerun or reaccept the 29-method regression from raw logs.
